nodes.label: AMPM Management — Final App Decision Brief & Developer Requirements
nodes.rationale: Consolidated business decisions (Part 2) and complete system requirements for development planning, architecture, feature design, access control and acceptance testing. Final instruction: build around AMPM's actual workflow; hotel discovery is an independent paid service; full planning and vendor management are exclusive to appointing clients; all permissions, subscription rules, approvals and retention enforced by the system.

nodes.label: AMPM Management Pvt. Ltd.
Project Overview — private wedding management platform for AMPM's own team and clients (not for licensing to other planners)
Four Connected Experiences (Public Website, Hotel Discovery Portal, Client Wedding Portal, AMPM Team App)
Public Website (company information, enquiry submission, demo requests, contact, login/invitation entry points)
nodes.rationale: AMPM staff will not have permission to edit public website content through the app in the initial scope; the website content management and public website editor described in the original decision brief are not approved for the current release.

nodes.label: Hotel Discovery Portal (paid, time-limited subscription for clients exploring wedding hotels)
Client Wedding Portal (available only to clients who appoint AMPM for complete planning and management)
AMPM Team App (internal management of clients, hotels, vendors, guests, hospitality and wedding-day departments)
Core Business Rule — Hotel Discovery and Complete Wedding Management Are Two Separate Services
nodes.rationale: A client can purchase hotel discovery without appointing AMPM; discovery does not unlock vendor selection or wedding management; full planning access only after mutual agreement; AMPM decides the management fee separately (never calculated or displayed in the subscription); all internal costs, margins, vendor quotations and negotiation details remain private.

nodes.label: Client Journey: Enquiry to Wedding Management (Stages 1-4)
Stage 1 — Enquiry and Demo (website enquiry; AMPM authorises demo; mobile + OTP; limited hotel info and sample pricing; optional 15-20 min Zoom call)

Demo Restrictions (AMPM-controlled; selected hotels/locations; up to three locations with street view; up to two sample hotels with indicative prices; exact limits to be finalised; no unlock of full database or wedding modules)

Stage 2 — Account Creation and Subscription (AMPM creates account or invitation; basic wedding details; pay fee; activation after payment; AMPM can create accounts, send invitations, manage demo access, activate/suspend subscriptions)
Stage 3 — Hotel Discovery Subscription (explore, compare, save favourites, submit enquiries; excludes complete planning and vendor selection)
Stage 4 — Appointment of AMPM for the Wedding (mutual confirmation; fee determined separately; agreement recorded; project created; client and team modules activated)
nodes.rationale: The system must not unlock the full wedding project simply because a client has purchased hotel discovery.

nodes.label: Hotel Discovery Subscription — INR 50,000, one-time payment, one month, renewable; read-only saved hotels and enquiries after expiry; no automatic deletion
nodes.rationale: The INR 50,000 fee must be configurable by AMPM through settings rather than permanently hard-coded.

nodes.label: Payment Method and Payment System (online card/UPI via a gateway chosen by AMPM; payment record with amount, date, status, transaction reference; activate after confirmation; prevent duplicate activation from repeated notifications; show start/expiry dates; staff review payment status)

Hotel Listing and Details (name/city/location, photos/videos, venues, room categories, approximate room/venue/package pricing, menu grid incl. veg/non-veg and per-plate, capacity, Street View/map, saved hotels, enquiry submission, availability-check requests, previous wedding photos only with permission)
nodes.rationale: Purpose: help clients understand a hotel's suitability and approximate cost before proceeding with further discussions.

nodes.label: Pricing Rules (indicative prices and ranges, never internal cost or margin; vary by season, dates, guest count, room category; last-verified date; distinguish indicative pricing from confirmed quotations; availability not assumed from price; AMPM updates prices without code changes)

Hotel Availability (no automated live calendar in the first release; request-based: client submits availability request or cart -> AMPM hotel team checks with the property -> records and shares response -> client compares; statuses indicative/requested/verified/awaiting confirmation)

Hotel Data Management (Eva maintains data and seasonal rates ~3 times a year; team can add/edit hotels, import from spreadsheets, update prices/packages, upload photos/menus, record verifier and date, mark outdated, manage media permissions)
nodes.rationale: Previous clients' wedding photographs must not be published without appropriate permission.

nodes.label: Authorised Family Representatives (two nominated: one bride side, one groom side; no additional accounts without AMPM authorisation; one shared login vs two authenticated accounts to be finalised)
nodes.rationale: Separate authenticated accounts with access to the same wedding are preferable for security and an audit history of who approved each decision (the compiled Q&A had assumed one shared login).

nodes.label: Client Permissions (view updates, hotel info, selected vendor profiles, proposals, designs, approvals; submit change requests; cannot edit RSVP list, see costs/margins/negotiations or other weddings; AMPM can record outside-portal decisions with a note)
Vendor Selection Locked During Hotel Discovery (available only after appointment and project activation)

Vendor Options (approximately five to ten per category — a guideline, not a software restriction; photography/videography, decor/production, catering, entertainment, makeup/styling, transport/logistics, others)
Vendor Information Visible to Clients (approved profile, portfolio, description, photos; view, compare, shortlist, select, submit for approval, review response, request changes)

Commercial Privacy Rule — vendor rates, quotations, negotiated amounts, costs, commissions, margins and negotiations never shown to clients through screens, exports, notifications or APIs; vendor contact details internal by default

Financial Information and Wedding Management Fees (fee determined separately after appointment; never auto-calculated from the subscription; client portal shows only approved info; internal records restricted; no online milestone payments in the first release unless AMPM approves)
Guest Invitation Links (separate bride-side and groom-side links; optional single combined link; each side private; no browsing the guest list after submission; no other household's information)

Guest RSVP Process (AMPM imports/creates list -> sends links -> guests confirm and provide information -> responses recorded -> RSVP team reviews and updates -> corrections via change/contact request routed to the RSVP caller)
Client Access to RSVP Information (representatives view approved guest updates and summaries; cannot edit the list or responses; corrections routed through the RSVP team)

Guest Data Fields (name, household, bride/groom side, attendance, number attending, meal preference, allergies, rooming, travel, change-request status; each guest counted individually including children)

Identity Documents (not compulsory; enabled per wedding where hotel check-in requires; restricted to authorised staff; avoid Aadhaar documents or numbers; restricted storage; AMPM-approved retention; retention period and privacy wording confirmed before launch)
AMPM Team App and Department Access (individual authenticated staff accounts; role- and department-controlled; a department manager on mobile sees only the sections relevant to their work)
Department Teams (hotel team, vendor team, RSVP team, hospitality team, production team, project manager, senior authorised management)
nodes.rationale: Functional examples only; the final role list and permissions must follow AMPM's approved staff structure.

nodes.label: Important Permission Rules (no automatic access to every department; internal financial information restricted; vendor and hotel costs hidden from unauthorised users; significant updates and approvals recorded against the responsible user; changes to approved items create a new version requiring approval)

Wedding-Day Operations and Offline Access (iOS/Android; offline access to assigned tasks, department info, readiness checklists, cue sheets, arrival lists; record updates offline; sync on reconnect; show offline and pending-sync state; no silent loss; conflict detection and resolution; protect locally stored data; limited to the user's role)
nodes.rationale: Offline access is required because some wedding venues have poor mobile network coverage; the developer should demonstrate offline changes being saved and synchronised, not just cached screens.

nodes.label: Readiness Checks (a function cannot be marked ready with incomplete required checks unless an authorised manager records an exception; record unmet check, exception and reason, authorised person, date/time, resulting status; exception authority configurable)
nodes.rationale: Only Eva is authorised to approve operational exceptions under the current business decision.

nodes.label: Closure (departmental checklists, vendor completion confirmation, guest and operational reconciliation, lost-and-found, final account records and approvals, feedback collection, archiving)

Post-Wedding Access and Archiving (client portal read-only for three months; then archived following AMPM approval; remains available to authorised staff; records not automatically deleted; reopening controlled by AMPM)
nodes.rationale: Archiving must be implemented as a change in status and access permissions, not as deletion of wedding data.

nodes.label: Tracked Requests (hotel enquiries, wedding arrangements, vendor selection, designs/menus, guest assistance, changes to approved information, general support; statuses Submitted, Under review, Accepted, Rejected, Implemented, Closed; conversation history per request)
Live Chat (home page help and communication option; distinguished from tracked requests so immediate conversations and formal change requests with approval history stay separate)
Change Requests (clients cannot directly alter approved items; AMPM reviews and accepts or rejects; an approved item that changes gets a new version with recorded approval)
Application Platforms (iOS and Android applications; offline operational use on the wedding day with automatic synchronisation; final architecture agreed with the development team)

Login and Authentication (prospects/demo: mobile + OTP, no self-registration for full access; clients: AMPM-created account or invitation, OTP, limited to the authorised wedding; staff: individual accounts, role- and department-based; staff method to be finalised)

System Configuration (commercial settings configurable without developer intervention: subscription price and duration, demo limits, hotel and vendor categories, pricing thresholds, change-request rules, access and approval settings; no hard-coded commercial rules)

Security Requirements (protect client, guest, hotel, vendor and financial data; keep costs and margins private; enforce permissions on the server, not just the interface; audit records; reliable backups and recovery; protect data stored offline; prevent cross-wedding access; AMPM approves hosting, retention, privacy wording and recovery targets)
Final Answers to the Original Decision Brief Questions Q1-Q25

First Release Scope (Q10): demo and subscription-based hotel discovery, wedding management after appointment, vendor selection, client portal, department-based team access, RSVP, tracked requests, live chat, offline wedding-day operations; only Eva authorises exceptions
Expected Scale (Q15): planning assumption of about 20 concurrent weddings and up to 200 hotels; staff and guest capacity to confirm
Communication Channels (Q11): email, WhatsApp and SMS proposed; implementation and provider to be confirmed
18 Important Business Rules to Preserve (mandatory for the development team)
nodes.rationale: No self-registration; AMPM controls demo and invitations; discovery separate from management at INR 50,000/month; expiry never deletes data; full access only after appointment; no vendor selection for discovery-only; costs hidden; two family representatives; guest privacy; department scoping; offline sync; only Eva authorises exceptions; live chat + tracked requests; no website editing; read-only three months then archive; configurable commercial settings; backend-enforced access.

nodes.label: Items to Confirm Before Development (demo duration and limits; one vs two sample hotels; payment gateway; shared vs separate representative logins; staff roles and cost visibility; hosting, backup and recovery; initial capacity; WhatsApp/SMS provider; privacy and retention periods; material-change thresholds; archiving and restore workflow)
Developer Acceptance Checklist (first-release scenarios that must pass before approval)

Recommendations Before Sending to Developer (separate client logins for an audit trail; finalise the demo hotel limit — notes conflict between 'one hotel per city' and 'two sample hotels'; demonstrate offline changes syncing after reconnect)
Eva (AMPM authority who approves operational exceptions and helps maintain hotel data)
